biography.en: Md Mahfuzul Islam is a Data Engineer with an Electrical and Electronic Engineering foundation, building applied AI systems and secure CMS platforms. His work emphasizes structured delivery: clear problem framing, validated pipelines, and maintainable operations across domains.

featuredProjects.title: Healthcare Data Integration & Analytics Pipeline
featuredProjects.summary: Clinical data integration workflow that transforms multi-source hospital records into validated, analysis-ready datasets.
featuredProjects.detail: Designed and implemented Python workflows to clean, validate, and harmonize patient records, laboratory data, and clinical metadata across multiple sources, with strong consistency checks for downstream analytics and research.
featuredProjects.impact: Enabled reliable analysis-ready healthcare datasets for research and reporting workflows.
contributions: Designed Python-based healthcare data processing pipelines
Harmonized large clinical datasets from multiple sources
Resolved duplicate records, ID mismatches, and irregular date formats
Integrated patient and laboratory data into a unified analytical dataset
Performed quality validation and standardization for research usage
featuredProjects.shortSummary: Clinical data integration workflow that transforms multi-source hospital records into validated, analysis-ready datasets.
featuredProjects.challenge: Clinical records arrived from multiple exports with inconsistent identifiers, date formats, and missing fields, reducing analytical reliability.
featuredProjects.solution: Built Python-based ingestion, cleaning, harmonization, and validation pipelines to standardize patient/lab records into a unified dataset.
outcomes: Reduced dataset inconsistency before analytics handoff through repeatable validation checks.
Delivered a unified clinical dataset structure suitable for reporting and research analysis.
Created reusable data-quality workflow patterns for future healthcare integrations.
featuredProjects.provenCapability: Healthcare data engineering from raw source integration to validated analytics-ready delivery.
proofAssets: Clinical data cleaning and validation ruleset

featuredProjects.title: Electrical Engineering RAG Bot
featuredProjects.summary: RAG-based engineering assistant with bilingual support, retrieval grounding, and source-cited technical answers.
featuredProjects.detail: Built as a practical AI toolchain for technical learning with retrieval over engineering sources, controllable reasoning detail, and configurable local/remote model support.
featuredProjects.impact: Demonstrates full-stack AI system design for engineering education.
featuredProjects.shortSummary: RAG-based engineering assistant with bilingual support, retrieval grounding, and source-cited technical answers.
featuredProjects.challenge: Technical learners needed reliable answers tied to textbook context rather than generic chatbot responses.
featuredProjects.solution: Designed a retrieval pipeline with document parsing, chunking, BM25 retrieval, and grounded generation with citation references.
outcomes: Produced citation-backed responses for engineering questions.
Enabled bilingual (English/Bengali) support with structured response formatting.
Demonstrated practical applied AI system assembly beyond model prompting alone.
featuredProjects.provenCapability: Applied AI systems engineering with retrieval architecture, explainability, and user-facing workflow design.

featuredProjects.title: EV Powertrain Simulation
featuredProjects.summary: EV powertrain simulation for battery sizing and control tradeoff analysis using MATLAB/Simulink.
featuredProjects.detail: Time-domain simulation explored acceleration, efficiency, and range tradeoffs to identify practical battery configuration strategies.
featuredProjects.shortSummary: EV powertrain simulation for battery sizing and control tradeoff analysis using MATLAB/Simulink.
featuredProjects.challenge: Needed to compare how battery sizing and controller settings affect acceleration, efficiency, and usable range.
featuredProjects.solution: Built Simulink powertrain models and evaluated multiple scenarios across time-domain performance indicators.
outcomes: Identified design tradeoffs between range targets and dynamic response.
Established repeatable simulation comparison setup for parameter exploration.
Generated evidence plots for performance-oriented design decisions.
featuredProjects.provenCapability: Simulation-led energy system analysis for practical engineering decision support.

featuredProjects.title: Breast Cancer Survival Prediction
featuredProjects.summary: Clinical survival modeling pipeline using SEER data with interpretable risk analysis outputs.
featuredProjects.detail: Applied statistical and machine learning survival modeling to support risk-aware clinical decision support analysis.
featuredProjects.shortSummary: Clinical survival modeling pipeline using SEER data with interpretable risk analysis outputs.
featuredProjects.challenge: Required a structured clinical ML workflow to estimate risk and compare survival model behavior on real-world outcome data.
featuredProjects.solution: Implemented preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation using Kaplan-Meier, Cox PH, and Random Survival Forest methods.
outcomes: Generated comparative survival analysis across classical and ML approaches.
Produced interpretable risk-oriented outputs for clinical analytics context.
Strengthened model-evaluation discipline for healthcare predictive workflows.
featuredProjects.provenCapability: Clinical ML pipeline design with statistical rigor and evaluation-focused decision support framing.

featuredProjects.title: Advanced Controller Design and Optimization (PMSM FOC)
featuredProjects.summary: PMSM field-oriented control redesign with PI tuning comparison and response robustness analysis.
featuredProjects.detail: Used series PI controller design, comparative tuning analysis, and simulation-based validation of dynamic response under parameter variations.
featuredProjects.impact: Showcases analytical controller design workflow from problem framing to quantitative validation.
featuredProjects.shortSummary: PMSM field-oriented control redesign with PI tuning comparison and response robustness analysis.
featuredProjects.challenge: Current-controller behavior required improved settling performance and robustness under varying operating parameters.
featuredProjects.solution: Used series PI redesign and simulation-based comparative tuning to evaluate dynamic response and stability margins.
outcomes: Improved response characterization for controller tuning decisions.
Documented tuning strategy comparison with response-curve evidence.
Mapped parameter sensitivity to practical control design choices.
featuredProjects.provenCapability: Control-system engineering using structured simulation evidence and quantitative tuning analysis.

featuredProjects.title: Nurul Amin MP Website Platform
featuredProjects.summary: Live bilingual public-service platform with secure admin CMS, citizen request flow, and operational publishing control.
featuredProjects.detail: Built and shipped as a secure Next.js platform with role-aware admin workflows, section-based CMS operations, request tracking, and media/document publishing for public communication.
featuredProjects.impact: Live in production for constituency communication and structured request handling.
featuredProjects.shortSummary: Live bilingual public-service platform with secure admin CMS, citizen request flow, and operational publishing control.
featuredProjects.challenge: Needed a production-ready public website that supports bilingual communication, structured service workflows, and controlled publishing.
featuredProjects.solution: Built a secure Next.js platform with role-aware admin, CMS section management, request tracking, and media/document operations.
outcomes: Launched a maintainable public communication platform for constituency services.
Enabled controlled publishing and structured request handling through admin workflows.
Provided reusable CMS architecture patterns for future civic platforms.
featuredProjects.provenCapability: Secure platform engineering and CMS workflow design for live public-service systems.

featuredProjects.title: My Personal Portfolio Platform
featuredProjects.summary: Secure portfolio platform with protected admin routes, schema-validated content updates, and blog CMS publishing controls.
featuredProjects.detail: Designed and implemented with protected admin routes, signed session handling, content validation, and reusable section-level CMS patterns for maintainable updates.
featuredProjects.impact: Demonstrates a private CMS architecture optimized for practical portfolio and product delivery updates.
featuredProjects.shortSummary: Secure portfolio platform with protected admin routes, schema-validated content updates, and blog CMS publishing controls.
featuredProjects.challenge: Required a maintainable personal platform that supports controlled content updates without exposing admin/security internals publicly.
featuredProjects.solution: Implemented protected admin authentication, CSRF/session controls, schema-validated content editing, and structured publishing workflows.
outcomes: Enabled safe content operations through role-aware admin workflows.
Created reusable CMS structures for project, experience, and blog updates.
Improved maintainability with data-driven content and centralized validation.
featuredProjects.provenCapability: Secure CMS and platform engineering with production-safe content operations.
proofAssets: Content model validation and publishing lifecycle

projects.title: Anomaly Detection Using Gaussian Model
projects.summary: Probabilistic anomaly detection workflow with threshold selection and F1-guided evaluation.
projects.detail: Built a probabilistic anomaly-detection workflow for server metrics using univariate and multivariate Gaussian models, threshold selection via F1 optimization, and false-positive control analysis for more reliable incident flagging.
projects.shortSummary: Probabilistic anomaly detection workflow with threshold selection and F1-guided evaluation.
projects.challenge: Needed reliable anomaly flagging with controlled false positives across server telemetry behavior.
projects.solution: Implemented univariate and multivariate Gaussian density models, then tuned thresholds through evaluation-based selection.
outcomes: Improved anomaly detection precision-recall balancing through threshold tuning.
Compared model behavior to support practical incident-flagging decisions.
projects.provenCapability: Applied ML workflow design with evaluation-first optimization under operational constraints.

projects.title: ECG Signal Denoising with Wiener Filtering
projects.summary: ECG denoising pipeline combining QRS detection and Wiener filtering for cleaner waveform analysis.
projects.detail: Implemented an ECG-cleaning pipeline combining synchronous averaging, QRS detection through cross-correlation, and Wiener filtering to improve signal quality for downstream waveform interpretation.
projects.shortSummary: ECG denoising pipeline combining QRS detection and Wiener filtering for cleaner waveform analysis.
projects.challenge: Raw ECG signals contained noise artifacts that reduced reliability of downstream waveform interpretation.
projects.solution: Combined synchronous averaging, cross-correlation QRS detection, and Wiener filtering for robust denoising.
outcomes: Improved ECG signal clarity while preserving diagnostically relevant waveform structure.
Created a repeatable filtering pipeline for biomedical signal preprocessing.
projects.provenCapability: Signal-processing workflow design for biomedical data preparation and quality enhancement.

projects.title: Image Thresholding for Background Removal
projects.summary: Threshold-based image preprocessing workflow for stable foreground extraction under near-white backgrounds.
projects.detail: Developed a threshold-based RGB preprocessing workflow to isolate foreground objects from white and near-white backgrounds, with parameter tuning for improved edge preservation and segmentation stability.
projects.shortSummary: Threshold-based image preprocessing workflow for stable foreground extraction under near-white backgrounds.
projects.challenge: Foreground extraction degraded around edges when backgrounds were near-white and lighting varied.
projects.solution: Implemented threshold segmentation with RGB tuning and post-processing steps to stabilize edge quality.
outcomes: Improved segmentation stability for white/near-white background cases.
Reduced edge-noise artifacts through parameter tuning and refinement steps.
projects.provenCapability: Image preprocessing pipeline development with evidence-driven parameter optimization.

Produced simulation evidence for system-level control understanding.
